entities.summary: Jilson Luis Antonio Bango is an Angolan professional basketball player for Fenerbahçe of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroLeague. He also represents the Angolan national team in international competition. Standing at 2.08 m, he plays at the power forward or the center position.
